title: Microplasma-synthesized Citrus-derived carbon quantum dots: antibacterial properties and nanoprobe sensitivity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25362-25371
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02150B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Minh Hoa, Le Duc Toan, Ngo Tran, Le Xuan Hung, Le Anh Thi
Citrus waste was converted into carbon quantum dots (CQDs) via one-step microplasma synthesis. The CQDs show antibacterial activity and act as fluorescent probes, offering green dual-functionality for biomedical applications.
